cards.title: Brand Lab
cards.text: Create your own mini brand, design products and make something to take home.
cards.imageAlt: Children printing their own T-shirt designs with a heat press

cards.title: Outdoor Resilience Day
cards.text: A full day outdoors building confidence, resilience and wellbeing, for young people who would otherwise never get the chance.
details: AQA certificated award for your CV
cards.imageAlt: Gavin Copland from Hustle Hive with two young people and their rucksacks on a sunny countryside walk

cards.title: Makers to Market
cards.text: A 12-week programme taking your handmade products from idea to real-world market sales.
cards.imageAlt: A maker peeling the backing off a vinyl design on a tote bag while a mentor looks on, with a heat press behind them

cards.title: Creatureverse: Rift Battles
cards.text: Design your own creature, turn it into a 3D-printed model, create trading cards and packaging, then battle it out in a final tournament.
cards.imageAlt: Creatureverse creatures at every stage: a hand-drawn sketch, a 3D model on a laptop, painted 3D-printed figures, boxed collectibles and trading cards
